data.title: 苍崎青子 · 练功后阳台的清爽晚风
data.description: 刚在木地板上结束一轮魔术体术热身，青子把毛巾搭在肩头，赤足推开洋馆二楼的窄阳台门透气。微汗沾湿了她额角的碎发，藏青工字背心利落地勾出紧实腰线，她一手叉腰、一手轻晃着冰矿泉水瓶，神态洒脱又充满锐气。
data.location: 久远寺洋馆二楼面向树林的窄木阳台
data.action: 肩搭白毛巾一手叉腰，另一手提着矿泉水瓶吹风休息
data.lighting: 斜照树梢的温暖橙红余晖打亮微汗肌肤
data.camera: 平视中景，林间暮色与洋馆栏杆作为背景
data.promptProse: Stepping onto the narrow wooden balcony of the Kuonji mansion after a workout, Aoko drapes a white towel across one shoulder and rests a hand on her hip while holding a chilled water bottle. Warm late-afternoon light catches the light sheen of sweat on her collarbone and midriff as breeze lifts her bangs.
data.animaCaption: With a towel over her shoulder and a water bottle in hand, she rests on the sunlit balcony after training.
